classification: Authored future controls; paper does not provide a full fault or disposal procedure

failure_cases.trigger: Unknown material/cell identity or composition convention
failure_cases.response: Quarantine condition before preparation; request corrected receipt

failure_cases.trigger: Missing safe-pressure qualification, shield/interlock validation or safe-release confirmation
failure_cases.response: No physical admission or coupling/uncoupling; refer to qualified operator/service

failure_cases.trigger: Leak, crack, changed gap/compliance, damaged seal, spill or unintended particle escape
failure_cases.response: Closed service enters approved safe state; isolate affected run, preserve logs; no pressure escalation or DIY repair

failure_cases.trigger: Unsettled/nonuniform initial state or inconsistent normalized filling record
failure_cases.response: Reject state; record preparation failure and create new approved child state rather than relabeling

failure_cases.trigger: Camera/DAQ desynchronization, clipping, dropped frames or unusable calibration
failure_cases.response: Hold cross-device metrics; preserve raw streams; rerun only under new approved run ID

failure_cases.trigger: Coral rate labels disagree or Boyle-law convention unresolved
failure_cases.response: Quarantine condition/model-derived conclusions without changing underlying source

failure_cases.trigger: Observed morphology differs from published illustration
failure_cases.response: Record real outcome; assess documented conditions and uncertainty, no forced classification or undocumented tuning

failure_cases.trigger: Missing branch, missing repeats, unavailable raw records or censored observation
failure_cases.response: Return incomplete/inconclusive status, never increment completed-program count

closeout_requirements: Qualified service confirms stopped input, safe pressure state and safe transfer before any opening or disconnection
Assign cell/mixture disposition and contained waste route under facility procedure; no disposal recipe inferred from paper
Inspect and record damage/contamination before reuse; any reloaded dispersion gets new state lineage
Archive immutable raw records, calibration/clock maps, derived versions, exclusion reasons and operator/service receipts
Audit all required branch outcomes plus unresolved holds; raw-data or physical claims remain false until separately evidenced
